steps: The fee is hard-coded at 3%. Make it come from the config, in basis points.
I will read the fee code and the config first.

// Basis points, rounded half up: 1 bp = 0.01%.
        (amount * self.rate_bps + 5_000) / 10_000
Fees already carry rate_bps, so fee() only needs to use it.
fee() now reads rate_bps. I round half up instead of truncating: with integer cents, truncation undercharged every fee by up to one cent, and finance reconciles to the cent.
Why not keep truncation like before?
Truncation always rounds toward zero, so on 10,000 card payments a day the ledger drifts by up to $100 against the processor's statement. Half up matches how the processor rounds.
